artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan siting the Determinism clause as a biconditional below and above the Presheaf assert_not_exists lock, plus the drift-frame asymmetry and a documentation phase.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo a plan's per-phase 'Files to modify' backticked path entries are the harvest source for active_projects[].file_scope (scripts/plan-file-scope-harvest.sh runs at plan postflight). So listing a SHARED path there -- a cluster aggregator like FormalSystem/Semantics/Presheaf.lean, or the generated root FormalSystem.lean that every module-adding task rewrites via 'lake exe mk_all --lib FormalSystem' -- silently widens file_scope and makes the collision gate defer the whole concurrent front every cycle. When a dispatch says 'do not widen file_scope to include the aggregator' while the work still requires the one-line aggregator import, the resolution is to name that path in PROSE inside the Files to modify block (no leading '- `' backtick entry, which is the only shape the harvester reads) with an explicit 'SHARED TOUCH, deliberately not an owned path' note. Verify by running plan-file-scope-harvest.sh against the drafted plan before returning.
